what_this_is: GLORYxR's predictions on the evaluated population, default SOM mode, as ranked distinct product SMILES

obtained_from.why_this_provider: its docstring states predictions will closely follow those of the original GLORYx implementation
obtained_from.environment_note: the project pins its dependencies in uv.lock; an environment built by a fresh resolve rather than `uv sync` may differ, and scikit-learn grants no guarantee for reading a pickle written by an older version -- its own warning says the load may give invalid results

drawing: the substrate as the corpus stores it, which is what every other arm was handed
